tokens.name: olive-700
tokens.usage: Deep olive. Hover/pressed for primary buttons, small olive text (7.4:1 with cream). Dark: light olive for headings.

tokens.name: olive-600
tokens.usage: Brand olive. Logo, primary buttons, links, active nav. 5.4:1 on cream-50, so OK for body-size text; cream-50 labels on it pass AA.

tokens.name: olive-300
tokens.usage: Soft olive. Decorative rules, illustration strokes, disabled fills. Never for text.

tokens.name: olive-100
tokens.usage: Sage tint. Selected rows, tag fields, recipe card headers.

tokens.name: walnut-600
tokens.usage: Walnut. Secondary accent, wood tones, prices, packaging bands. 7.3:1 on cream-50.

tokens.name: honey-500
tokens.usage: Honey accent. Seasonal highlights and rating stars only; large text or non-text in light theme (2.9:1).

tokens.name: cream-50
tokens.usage: Page background. Light: warm cream, never yellow. Dark: warm charcoal for low-light kitchen use.

tokens.name: paper-0

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Decorative contrast only; pair controls with ink-600 borders.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Primary text on cream-50, linen-100, paper-0 (14:1+).

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, control borders (5.9:1 on linen-100).
